description:
Highlight map routes using your own priorities.

[h2]Routes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Two ready-to-use presets, with five editable colour groups
[*]Rank room counts or prefer having or avoiding a room type
[*]Prefer lower or higher average floors for each room type
[*]Recalculate from your current room in every act
[/list]
Tied routes stay highlighted. Overlapping groups mix their colours.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
Open the map and click the gear to edit priorities. Hover over an icon for its meaning. The toolbar appears only on the map.
